    // The Casement possesses the flagship, the same default every

You moved the DEFAULT. cli/src/main.rs:845 now reads

documents LandSettlement as the target since The Tidemark. So every committed
transcript regenerated on land -- and this one line, which hardcodes Flagship
while its COMMENT claims to be following "the same default every committed
transcript depends on", kept the old subject and sailed into the water.

The comment was true when The Quire wrote it. It is false now, and it is
exactly why you did not think to look here: it reads as tracking a shared
default rather than pinning a value. Same failure mode as the retired-Orrery
paragraph in CLAUDE.md, in a code comment instead of a guide.

ABI boundary and decision 0055 runs the determinism guarantee through it, so it
